metric_semantics.crazygames.rating: Displayed score labeled last six months; scale maximum not explicitly present in observed text. Not a usage metric.
metric_semantics.crazygames.likes: Displayed positive vote count; accumulation window unspecified. K means 1000, M means 1000000; rounding method unknown.
metric_semantics.crazygames.dislikes: Displayed negative vote count; same precision and time-window limits as likes.
metric_semantics.crazygames.plays: No game-level plays observed; null is not zero.
metric_semantics.crazygames.active_users: No game-level active users observed; never inferred from votes.

limitations: 20 section observations, 20 unique games, five unique homepage detail inspections; bounded nonrandom sample.
Homepage US label is not a global ranking. DOM positions are not official ranks.
Hot monthly title conflicts with last-24-hours introductory wording; no inferred unified window.
Uncollected metrics are null; ratings, votes and plays are distinct. Category tag counts are not per-game metrics.

All 20 current rendered cover URLs were downloaded through the cloud browser, fully decoded and SHA-256/size verified; same-content existing repository blobs are reused. Browser download API does not expose HTTP headers/status.
Descriptions outside current detail sample remain null because current gameplay evidence was not collected.
No hidden API, login, manual gameplay or video; embedded games may auto-load.
Source cover rights remain with owners; no redistribution license asserted.

data_policy.content_storage: factual game discovery metadata and short assistant-generated Chinese summaries
data_policy.rights_note: Source images remain owned by their respective rights holders. Downloading and public visibility do not establish a redistribution license. No full descriptions, videos, game code or other game assets stored.
